overall_comment: The imaging findings in this 65-year-old patient are highly characteristic of a glioblastoma. The combination of advanced age, multifocal disease, deep structural invasion, and the presence of necrosis strongly supports the diagnosis of Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype, CNS WHO grade 4.
